sentences.text:
Devendra Rajput (Lodhi ) vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15
May, 2024
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 15 th Of May, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 19912 of 2024
 Between:-
 Devendra Rajput (Lodhi ) S/O Shri Gariba
 Rajput, Aged About 23 Years, Occupation:
 Agriculturist Resident Of Village Duda P.S.

Badagaon District Tikamgarh (Madhya
 Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri S.K. Mishra - Advocate )
 And
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh Through Police
 S T A T I O N Badagaon District Tikamgarh
 (Madhya Pradesh)
 .
 (By Shri C.M. Tiwari - Govt. Advocate)

This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:
 Order

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.5/2024 registered at Police Station - Badagaon District Tikamgarh for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(2)(n) of IPC,
Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(v), 3(1)(Da), 3(1)(Dha), 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST Act.

Applicant is in detention since 02.02.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is that he committed sexual intercouse with the minor proscutrix forcefully.
On the basis of aforesaid, FIR was registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is submitted by counsel for applicant that age of prosecutrix is 17 years 6 months and 22 days at the time of incident.
Prosecutrix herself went to Ahmedabad with the applicant.
Prosecutrix in her statements recorded u/S/.164 of Cr.P.C. has not stated against the present applicant.
He is in custody since 02.02.2024.
Applicant has no criminal past.
Trial of the case will take some considerable period of time.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicants, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PRAMOD KUMAR AGRAWAL) JUDGE Shub Devendra Rajput (Lodhi ) vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176173851/
